rotation.title: Rotation Plans
rotation.scoreNote: Heuristic comparison score — not a yield prediction.
rotation.outdatedBanner: This analysis was generated with an older farm profile. Re-run rotation to update.
rotation.priorityHelp: Starts from the farm profile. Changing these here affects this run only.
rotation.weightsZero: At least one priority must be above zero.
rotation.empty: No analysis yet. Generate rotation plans to compare options.
rotation.fewerThanThree: Fewer than three plans are feasible; see limitations for why.
rotation.cannotSaveOutdated: This analysis is outdated. Re-run before saving.
rotation.balanceHelp: Balance = available water − demand; negative means a shortfall
rotation.deficitUnknown: Deficit is unknown because an input (e.g. irrigation supply) is unknown.
rotation.reasonsTitle: Why some plans are not shown

compHelp.water_sufficiency: Water sufficiency is a screening estimate using total modeled rainfall; effective rainfall and field losses are not yet modeled.
compHelp.crop_diversity: Crop diversity is a rotation-structure proxy, not a measured soil-health change.
compHelp.scenario_resilience: Scenario resilience describes a hypothetical rainfall adjustment, not a weather forecast.

rotation.renormalized: Their weight is set to 0 and the remaining weights are renormalized.
rotation.smallDifferences: Small score differences are not statistically meaningful.
rotation.waterWording: Water sufficiency is a screening estimate using total modeled rainfall; effective rainfall and field losses are not yet modeled.
rotation.noSeasonWater: No per-season water screening available for this plan.
rotation.planAggregate: Plan aggregate (optional, does not replace per-season values)
rotation.needsObservation: Load this farm's observations first: the analysis needs an observation snapshot for the current farm version.
rotation.seasonLabelsHelp: Choose the season for each step. The engine does not infer a calendar from the number of seasons.
rotation.modeHelp: Soil and recovery modes are waiting for approved soil/recovery rules.

plan.title: Saved Plan
plan.inputSnapshot: Farm inputs at time of analysis
plan.outdatedBanner: Farm inputs have changed since this plan was saved.

financial.title: Financial Scenario
financial.disclaimer: Outputs are illustrative arithmetic ranges from the inputs above — not forecasts, profit promises, crop recommendations or guarantees. Range endpoints are not confidence intervals.
financial.costsHelp: Each category is a low–high range in {{currency}} per hectare per crop cycle. Leave blank if unknown, or remove categories that do not apply; removed standard categories are listed beside the results.
financial.sourcesHelp: Add one record per source, then link each cost, yield and price input to the source(s) that support it. A single generic source for the whole calculation is not enough when inputs come from different places.
financial.fixInputs: Fix the highlighted inputs to see results.
financial.specStatus: Financial specification v{{version}} — formulas approved by Bhagya with implementation conditions.
financial.dataPending: Input data status: pending sourced local values. Enter values with traceable sources; synthetic examples are not market or yield evidence.
financial.noSourcesYet: Add a source record above to link it here.
financial.syntheticInputs: Synthetic inputs in use: these results are arithmetic examples, not Sri Lankan market or yield evidence.

messages.bothBounds: Enter both low and high, or leave both unknown
messages.sourceRequired: Link at least one source to this input
messages.currency: Use a 3-letter currency code, e.g. LKR
messages.area: Area must be greater than zero
messages.reference: Enter an http(s) URL or a document reference
messages.accessDate: Access date cannot be before the quoted date
messages.sourceArea: Market or production area is required
messages.kind: Choose farmer-entered, observed, researched or synthetic
messages.totalUnknown: Total cost and net are unknown while any cost category is unknown
messages.breakEvenUnknown: Break-even price is unknown when the minimum yield is 0
messages.synthetic: Some inputs are synthetic examples, not Sri Lankan market or yield evidence.
messages.differentAreas: Inputs come from different market/production areas; check that they are comparable.
messages.differentGrades: Inputs refer to different crop varieties/grades; check that they are comparable.
messages.periodAssumption: Period: one crop cycle. Costs and yields are per hectare per cycle; price is farm-gate currency per kg.
messages.netAssumption: Net range uses conservative interval arithmetic: low = lowest revenue − highest cost; high = highest revenue − lowest cost. Endpoints are not equally likely and are not confidence intervals.
messages.rounding: Results are rounded for display only.
messages.unlinked: Sources not linked to any input: {{value}}.
messages.spec: Specification v{{version}} ({{ref}}); formulas approved by Bhagya with implementation conditions.

common.fixtureMode: Fixture mode: all data shown is synthetic and for interface development only.

catalog.title: Crop catalog validation
catalog.intro: The rotation engine only uses a catalog that passes these checks. Entries must be researched and approved before they influence recommendations.
catalog.invalid: Catalog has {{count}} problem(s) and cannot be used.
catalog.invalidBlocking: The crop catalog failed validation, so results cannot use it.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.emptyNoteFixture: The crop catalog has no approved crops yet; plans shown here are synthetic fixtures, not recommendations.
catalog.emptyNoteLive: The crop catalog has no approved crops yet, so the live engine returns no plans until crops are approved.
catalog.empty: Catalog is empty; research and approval are required before recommendations.
catalog.draftNote: {{count}} crop(s) are drafts and will not be used for recommendations.
catalog.unknownWaterNote: {{count}} crop(s) have unknown water demand (null, not zero).

messages.object: Catalog must be a JSON object
messages.cropObject: Crop entry must be an object
messages.nullableString: Must be a non-empty string or null (unknown)
messages.strings: Must be an array of strings
messages.water: Invalid unit/value: must be a positive number of millimetres per cycle, or null when unknown
messages.sourceRequired: Approved crops need at least one source
messages.seasonRequired: Approved crops need at least one season
messages.familyRequired: Approved crops need a reviewed family
messages.reviewed: A reviewed catalog needs at least one crop and all crops approved

roadmap.title: Planned features

landing.title: Grow with the planet,
landing.description: Bring Earth observations and your farm knowledge together. Explore crop rotations, understand your water needs, and plan the next season with context.
landing.challenge: Built for NASA Space Apps 2026 · Field Shift
landing.fieldNote: A longer view of your land
landing.fieldDescription: Compare seasons, crops, and climate conditions in one connected workspace.
landing.fieldFooter: Your inputs. Clear sources. Visible uncertainty.
landing.sourceNote: Regional context, with coverage and limitations
landing.platformTitle: Make room for a better next season.
landing.observeDescription: Explore rainfall and temperature histories with source metadata, missing days, and regional context.
landing.planDescription: Explore multi-season crop comparisons and water trade-offs in the clearly labeled synthetic demo.
landing.understandDescription: Inspect assumptions and limitations alongside results. Keep local knowledge part of every decision.
landing.status: Try the synthetic demo to explore the full journey. Live farm, NASA POWER observation, and rotation-analysis APIs are available; scenario, assistant, and saved-plan API connections are still in progress. Crop entries remain drafts, so the live rotation API returns no candidates until they are reviewed and approved.
landing.workspaceTitle: Pick up where you left off.
landing.footer: Earth data. Local knowledge. Thoughtful farming.
